fields.plant_name: Hylic (Heyuan Lithium Innovation) Huai'an liquid-solid (semi-solid) battery plant

rows.notes: Discovery add (T038, Jiangsu). CarNewsChina 2026-01-11 (S1/S2): Hylic's first dedicated liquid-solid battery factory in Jiangsu commenced operations in Q4 2025; plan = 10 GWh line in three phases (1 GWh, 2 GWh, 7 GWh; phase 1 = 20.84 acres, RMB 500m; phases undated) -> nameplate 10, ref_year: fallback, searched (2026 = publication year; no phase dated; D-021 n/a). No installed GWh stated (phase 1 = 1 GWh is a plan figure; not used as installed). SITE IDENTIFICATION IS INFERRED: CarNewsChina says only 'Jiangsu' and that Hylic is 'known as Heyuan Lithium Innovation in China' (S3) and HQ in Suzhou; SMM (S4, 2025-01-02) reports the first phase of the solid-state intelligent mass-production site of 'Heyuan Lithium (Huaian) New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.' topped out 22 Dec 2024 in Huai'an District, line due Q2 2025. Same company name, same technology, matching timeline -> treated as one Huai'an plant; if Hylic has another Jiangsu site this row is mislocated (confidence capped at 0.5). Chemistry 'semi-solid-state' mapped from 'liquid-solid state' wording (press term) - unconfirmed. Not in factories_export or removed.csv (grepped Hylic/Heyuan Lithium/Huaian). No coordinates.

fields.plant_name: Yunshi Weilan solid-state lithium battery production base (Jiangning, Nanjing)

rows.notes: Discovery add (T038, Jiangsu). Signed 10 Jan 2026 at the Jiangning District Industrial Technology Innovation Conference (Jiangning Development Zone, Nanjing), RMB 5.2bn; the base is to produce 'solid-state lithium batteries, battery packs, energy storage equipment and related products' with a stated annual capacity of 15 GWh (S5/S6). Scope caveat: the 15 GWh headline covers cells plus packs/equipment; the cell share is not stated, so the figure may overstate cell capacity -> confidence 0.4. Status announced: a signing at an investment-promotion conference; no construction start, phases or dates found (no later news located; web-search budget was exhausted during this task so a freshness check was not possible). ref_year: fallback, searched (2026 = publication year). Operator's Chinese name and ownership not stated on the page (English 'Yunshi Weilan' only); may be linked to WeLion (卫蓝) by name - not confirmed, parent left null; the existing WeLion row is Huzhou, a different site. Not in factories_export or removed.csv. No coordinates.

fields.plant_name: Zhejiang Dangzhuo Energy anode-free solid-state cell project (Nanhu, Jiaxing)

rows.notes: Discovery add (T038, Zhejiang). EnergyTrend roundup (2026-03-27, date from URL): the 5 GWh/yr 'novel battery cells/modules (anode-free solid-state)' industrialization project of Zhejiang Dangzhuo Energy was filed for record on 23 March 2026, located in Nanhu District, Jiaxing (S10/S11); construction 'set to begin in June 2026', completion targeted November 2026 (S12). Same article: the company 'targets a total planned annual capacity of 40GWh' (S13) and a Phase I of 10 GWh with production expected July 2026, with no city given for that phase - these are NOT attributed to the Jiaxing site (D-015/undated total, location unstated), so nameplate = the filed 5 GWh; conflict (5 vs Phase I 10) noted. Status announced: filing only; no evidence construction actually began in June 2026 (no later news located; search budget exhausted, freshness unchecked) -> confidence 0.4. ref_year 2026 = stated completion target Nov 2026 (construction completion, not a 达产 statement) and also the publication year; flagged as fallback. 'Cells/modules' wording - cell scope plausible, module share unknown. Not in factories_export (grepped Dangzhuo/Jiaxing). Different from the existing Hu Na Energy Jiaxing row. No coordinates.

Discovery add (T038, Jiangsu). TrinaStorage company release reposted by solarbe.com 2025-09-25 (S14): the Dafeng base 'officially went into production', equipped with workshops for cell preparation (电芯制备), module assembly, performance verification and safety testing. Dafeng is a district of Yancheng, Jiangsu (general knowledge; the page does not name the province). Capacity: NOT disclosed for this site. The only GWh figures are company-wide portfolio capacity ('after Dafeng phase II is fully in production, Trina Storage portfolio capacity reaches 25GWh', S15; 16 GWh before per another Trina release) which cover systems and several sites incl. Chuzhou - not a site cell nameplate, so nameplate null. Cell vs system: the page lists cell preparation among the workshops but does not give cell output; confidence 0.4. start_year 2025 from 'recently officially in production' (Sept 2025). Chemistry/format not stated (Trina ESS cells are LFP in other sources - not confirmed here). Existing row trina-storage-chuzhou-lfp-cell-gigafactory-china is the Chuzhou site (its notes already flag Dafeng as a separate site). Not in removed.csv. No coordinates.

The table shows Zhejiang Liwei revenue of ~RMB 5.12bn and net profit ~RMB 0.60bn for 2025 (columns: 注册资本 163,500.00; 营业收入 511,538.02; 净利润 60,052.45, in RMB 10k; read from a garbled PDF table, not quoted) which indicates real production, so status operational; per D-016 a subsidiary table alone supports existence only, hence confidence 0.4 and this basis is stated here. Capacity: NOT disclosed in GWh (consumer cells are quoted in cells/day; a 2021 plan of ~800k cells/day after three phases appeared only in search summaries, not used). One row covers both Lanxi entities (one physical site). Chemistry/format not stated (consumer 3C cells are usually LCO; unconfirmed). announced_year left null (a March 2021 Sunwoda-Lanxi government JV announcement was seen only in a search summary). Not the Sunwoda Yiwu EVB row or the Quzhou row. Not in removed.csv. No coordinates.
